name: CRM - Konversi Lead per Cabang
query:
SELECT
    x.unit AS "Unit:Data:220",
    x.total_leads AS "Total Leads:Int:120",
    x.terdaftar AS "Terdaftar:Int:120",
    CONCAT(REPLACE(CAST(x.konversi AS CHAR), '.', ','), '%%') AS "Konversi:Data:110"
FROM (
    SELECT nama_unit AS unit, 0 AS sortkey,
        COUNT(*) AS total_leads,
        SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar') AS terdaftar,
        ROUND(100*SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS konversi
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY nama_unit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TOTAL (gabungan)' AS unit, 1 AS sortkey,
        COUNT(*) AS total_leads,
        SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar') AS terdaftar,
        ROUND(100*SUM(status_lead='Terdaftar')/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS konversi
    FROM `tabRumba Lead`
    WHERE tanggal_lead BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
) x
ORDER BY x.sortkey, x.unit

name: Daftar Tunggu (FIFO)
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Lead:Link/Rumba Lead:140",
    nama_calon AS "Nama Calon:Data:160",
    nomor_handphone AS "No. HP:Data:120",
    nama_unit AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:140",
    program_diminati AS "Program:Link/Rumba Program Belajar:130",
    tanggal_masuk_tunggu AS "Masuk Tunggu:Date:120",
    catatan_tunggu AS "Catatan:Data:240"
FROM `tabRumba Lead`
WHERE status_lead = 'Daftar Tunggu'
ORDER BY tanggal_masuk_tunggu ASC, creation ASC

name: Mutasi Murid
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Mutasi:Link/Rumba Mutasi:130",
    nama_murid AS "Murid:Data:160",
    unit_asal AS "Unit Asal:Link/Rumba Unit:130",
    unit_tujuan AS "Unit Tujuan:Link/Rumba Unit:130",
    status_mutasi AS "Status:Data:100",
    tanggal_mutasi AS "Tanggal:Date:100",
    tunggakan_unit_asal AS "Tunggakan:Currency:120",
    rekap_bintang AS "Bintang:Int:80"
FROM `tabRumba Mutasi`
ORDER BY tanggal_mutasi DESC, creation DESC

name: Pengunduran Diri Murid
query:
SELECT
    name AS "No.:Link/Rumba Pengunduran Diri:140",
    nama_murid AS "Murid:Data:160",
    nama_unit AS "Unit:Link/Rumba Unit:120",
    kategori AS "Kategori:Data:90",
    tanggal_pemberitahuan AS "Diberitahu:Date:100",
    tanggal_efektif AS "Efektif:Date:100",
    notice_terpenuhi AS "Notice H-14:Check:90",
    status_pengunduran AS "Status:Data:90",
    tunggakan AS "Tunggakan:Currency:110"
FROM `tabRumba Pengunduran Diri`
ORDER BY tanggal_efektif DESC, creation DESC
